# Pixel Poll

A simple offline browser-based poll app with 4 options. Vote by clicking an option, see live vote counts and percentage bars, change your vote, and reset all votes.

## Features

- 4 poll options with vote counts and percentage bars
- Click to vote; click another option to change your vote
- Reset votes button clears all votes
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout (works from 360px wide)
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `styles.css` – styling and layout
- `script.js` – poll logic
